examples.explanation: From cell (1,2) the distances to the three buildings are 3, 3 and 1, totalling 7, which beats every other empty cell.
Either empty cell sits one step from each of the two buildings, for a total of 2.
There is no empty land to build on.

hints: Run a breadth-first search from every building over passable cells, accumulating distances into a totals table.
Keep a reach-count per cell recording how many buildings reached it; only cells reached by all buildings are eligible.
Walk only through empty land during each search; buildings and obstacles block movement.
title: 406. Shortest Distance from All Buildings
